title: Full Surrender of an Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities Contract — Effective Date and Surrender Value
content:
## Contract provision: surrender (Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities)

**1. Right to surrender.** The owner may surrender the contract, including after lifetime withdrawals have begun.

**2. Signatures.** A full surrender is processed only on a surrender request signed by the owner, and by any irrevocable beneficiary and assignee of record. The signatures are read from Ashgrove's service request record for that surrender request — its request type, signed date and request status — before the surrender is processed and paid.

**3. Effective date.** The surrender is effective on the date the signed request is received in good order, with fixed interest credited to that date and no index credit for the partial contract year.

**4. Surrender charge.** The surrender charge is the contract value less the remaining free withdrawal amount, multiplied by the surrender charge percentage for the contract year from the tier's schedule, rounded to the cent. The remaining free withdrawal amount is the tier's free withdrawal share of the contract value on the latest contract anniversary, less withdrawals already taken in the current contract year, never below zero; in a contract year before free withdrawals become available it is zero.

**5. Bonus recapture.** On a bonus tier the unvested bonus — the bonus credited multiplied by one less the vested share for the contract year — is also recaptured.

**6. Minimum.** The result — the contract value less the surrender charge and any recaptured bonus — is never less than the state minimum nonforfeiture value.

**7. Lifetime benefit and payment.** Surrender ends any lifetime withdrawal benefit. Ashgrove may defer payment up to the tier's longest surrender payment deferral.

### Worked surrender values (hypothetical figures)

**A. Ashgrove IndexEdge 7, contract year 3, schedule 7%, free share 10%.**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Contract value on the effective date | 120000 |
| Contract value on the latest anniversary | 118000 |
| Withdrawals already taken this contract year | 0 |
| Remaining free withdrawal amount: 10% of 118000 | 11800.00 |
| Amount bearing the charge: 120000 less 11800.00 | 108200.00 |
| Surrender charge: 7% of 108200.00 | 7574.00 |
| Result: 120000 less 7574.00 | 112426.00, unless the state minimum nonforfeiture value is higher |

**B. Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus, contract year 4, schedule 7%, vested share 30%, free share 10%.**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Contract value on the effective date | 110000 |
| Contract value on the latest anniversary | 107000 |
| Withdrawals already taken this contract year | 4000 |
| Remaining free withdrawal amount: 10700.00 less 4000 | 6700.00 |
| Surrender charge: 7% of 103300.00 | 7231.00 |
| Unvested bonus: bonus credited 7000 multiplied by 70% | 4900.00 |
| Result: 110000 less 7231.00 less 4900.00 | 97869.00, unless the state minimum nonforfeiture value is higher |

### Points of judgement

- *Surrender request signed by the owner, but an irrevocable beneficiary of record has not signed.* Not processed.
- *Request received in good order on a date in the middle of the contract year.* Fixed interest is credited to that date; no index credit is credited for the partial year.
- *Surrender of an Ashgrove IncomeShield contract in income phase.* Allowed; the lifetime withdrawal benefit ends.
